dedupe_keys.name: geophysical wireline well logs from alberta environment and sustainable resource development water well drill hole data holdings in log ascii standard las format

description: The collection digitises water-well geophysical logs, mainly resistivity, into Log ASCII Standard version 2. The source lists 8,763 LAS files with a tab-delimited index and says about 1% contain natural-gamma logs. The project ran from 2002 to March 2007, but original well-measurement dates are not established. Its extent is approximately 49–56°N and 110–120°W. There are 205 records whose identifiers begin with 900 and whose surface locations could not be matched confidently. LAS here means well logs, not LiDAR point clouds. An archive descriptor labels ASCII GRID, conflicting with the description. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
